name: [💫UPDATE 0.25💫] Anime Genesis
desc:
🎉Welcome to Anime Genesis! 🎉

In this chaotic, physics-driven auto-battler, you’ll recruit powerful units, build clever strategies, and unleash devastating abilities against relentless enemies! 💥
Watch battles come alive with real-time physics, unpredictable interactions and Anime-like battles!

🙏 Thank You for Playing!
Your support means the world to us. More units, abilities, maps, challenges & events coming soon!
